title: Routine cross-host send rejects a known Mac root as local-only
outcome: Restore supported durable routine messaging to an identity-bound known remote root without manual proxying, while preserving authorization and truthful delivery outcomes.
acceptance: The reported known remote root can receive a routine message through the supported cross-host path, or the caller receives a precise actionable refusal for a genuine capability, identity or transport limitation rather than the incorrect local-only rejection.
Regression controls cover remote root routing, local root compatibility, invalid/non-root targets, authorization and idempotent retry without duplicate delivery.
The repaired package includes focused test results and the required independent review pair; integration retains the maintained exact-tree full gate.
